svg.title: What lives in the repository and what lives on your server
svg.desc: Diagram. Left: the public repository on GitHub holds code, tests, docs and example configs with placeholders only, guarded by a CI hygiene test. Right: your server holds panter.env with your secrets, accounts and domain; downstream.json with your MCP servers; the data directory with the SQLite ledger, OAuth clients and tokens and audit; and the backups. deploy.sh installs an exact commit from the repository on the server; nothing flows back. Connecting a new MCP server means editing downstream.json, adding its token to panter.env and restarting: no repository change.
